observed_response.question: Is headset check completion approved by someone? Who?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Theatre headset check concerns rehearsal communications. Mute the console, connect the test loop, and run the channel check before unmuting. The audio lead authorizes completion. Reserve 6 minutes for the check. The rehearsal rack contains 18 headsets. The stage manager schedules rehearsals but does not authorize headset check completion. [1]

Observatory lens case logging records storage inspections. Check the case identifier, photograph the protective cap, then enter the inspection in the lens log. The optics custodian signs the inspection record. Repeat the case inspection every 72 hours. The storage cabinet holds 6 lens cases. Do not remove the lens from its case for this logging task. Lens focal lengths are outside this storage record. [2]

Bicycle demonstration check-in applies to display bikes returned from a supervised demo. Read the frame tag, note the odometer reading, then park the bike in bay C. The rental marshal owns check-in discrepancies. Keep the bike in bay C for 35 minutes before reassignment. The display area has 10 bicycles. A missing key must be recorded; this document does not set a replacement fee. [3]
